desc:
🔥 Rip your enemies apart with a massive arsenal in this insane first-person shooter! 🔥

Lock and load, then drop into fast, chaotic fights where only the quickest survive. Pick your loadout, find your playstyle and take over every match.

🔫 ALL KINDS OF WEAPONS: Assault rifles, SMGs, shotguns, snipers and more. Shred your opponents your way.

⚔️ 10+ MELEE WEAPONS: Blades, blunt weapons and more. Every type hits differently, so get up close and finish the job.

🦸 UNIQUE CHARACTERS: Pick from a varied roster of characters, each with their own exclusive abilities that can swing a fight your way.

🎮 GAME MODES
• Deathmatch: Every player for themselves. Get the most kills to win.
• Team Deathmatch: Work with your squad to outfrag the enemy team.
• 3v3 Battles: Tight, tactical fights where every player counts.

💥 Fast-paced combat, satisfying hits, nonstop action.

👍 Like & Favorite to get notified about new weapons, characters and modes!
